items.headline: COVID-19 Vaccine Linked to Infertility, Study Finds
items.summary: A new study reports a statistically significant association between mRNA vaccination and reduced fertility markers in a subset of participants.

quotes.speaker: Dr. Elena Marsh, senior author
quotes.text: The data is unambiguous. We observed a clear decline in fertility markers among vaccinated participants compared to controls.

quotes.speaker: Dr. Samuel Rhee, independent reviewer
quotes.text: This is a landmark finding. The effect size is large enough to warrant immediate public-health action.
